name: Moritasgus
text: Moritasgus is an occasional epithet attached to the Gaulish Apollo. Worship of the god under such titles spread through the Gaulish provinces in the Roman period.

attributes.attribute: occasional epithet of the Gaulish Apollo
title recorded for Apollo in Gaul

okr.objective: Documents Moritasgus as recorded in MacKillop 2008 for the Public Celtic Encyclopedia.
key_results: Moritasgus serves as an occasional epithet of the Gaulish Apollo.
The name belongs to the record of Apollo worship in Gaul.
